name: GR 12 Vlaanderen, Bruxelles - Braine-le-Château
description_md:
The GR 12 Vlaanderen, Bruxelles - Braine-le-Château is a hard waymarked hiking route located in BE. It covers a distance of 38.7 km with 705 m of ascent and 695 m of descent.

The walking time is about 12 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and the difficulty is derived from the distance and ascent. This route is part of an international waymarked hiking network. Along the way, the route passes Brussels within 100 m, Conservatoire royal de Bruxelles - Koninklijk Conservatorium Brussel within 100 m, and Manneken Peace within 100 m.
